note: Alberta Parks provincial park on Thunder Lake, 21 km west of Barrhead on Hwy 18: well-treed loops back from the lake, with a beach, pier and boat launch in the day-use area and a Saturday farmers market by the check-in station; new service building (2026). The campground is next to the Barrhead gun range. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page, the shop site list and the January 2026 tear sheet: 61 unserviced C$39 + 64 power (15/30 A) C$47, reservable May 15 - Sep 15 on the Alberta Parks shop (platform reserveamerica -> operator), max rig 60 ft, showers/flush/tap water/dump/store written. Season (manual) agrees. Not waterfront confirmed; pin ~900 m off.
flags: PIN (54.12150,-114.71100) is ~900 m SE of the campground, in the woods by the access road near the cottage subdivision. The tear sheet's loops, scaled to imagery: day-use parking ~54.1249,-114.7219; Loop A ~54.1243,-114.7191; Loop B ~54.1286,-114.7242; Loop C ~54.1304,-114.7252. Recommend ~54.1265,-114.7220 (main campground road between Loops A and B). The page's directions point is 54.129067,-114.724555 (between Loops B and C).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront CONFIRMED. On the tear sheet's campground map (50 m scale) the nearest pads (Loop B 44-48, Loop C 90-95) are ~80-150 m from the shore with a trail and continuous forest between; imagery shows unbroken canopy between the loops and the lake. The beach, pier and boat launch are in the day-use area.
ADVISORY (dated): 'Blue-Green Algae' in Thunder Lake since June 22, 2026, 'in effect until further notice'.
GUN RANGE: page 'The Campground is adjacent to the Barrhead gun range.' Kept in the note.

SEASON: stored May 15 - Sep 15 (manual 2026-10-20) agrees with the page; not rewritten. Shop 'Closed through Thu May 20 2027' (the 2027 opening).

WEBSITE: stored park root + shop link; recommend the campground page https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/central/thunder-lake-pp/information-facilities/camping/thunder-lake/ (200) plus the shop link.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').
